purpose: Specify how the molecule is cleared from CSF and interstitial fluid (so concentration reflects current release rate, not historical accumulation).

specification.rationale: Too short (<30 min) — concentration noisy, hard to measure. Too long (>180 min) — concentration integrates over hours of release, loses real-time signal.
specification.clearance_mechanism: One or more of: (a) enzymatic degradation in CSF, (b) bulk clearance via arachnoid granulations, (c) renal clearance after entering systemic circulation, (d) hepatic clearance
specification.clearance_must_be_predictable: Variation in clearance rate across patients < 3x (otherwise inverse model is unreliable)

what_unfreezes_this: Step 1 (molecule — determines which clearance mechanism applies and the rate).
validation_required: In vitro: molecule degradation rate in synthetic CSF at 37°C, with and without CSF enzymes
In vivo (animal): clearance rate from CSF after bolus injection
Across patient variability: how does clearance rate vary with age, kidney function, liver function?
